items.note: Page read in full: Outdoor Parking about 100 m from the valley station; 'Von 00:00 - 17:00 Uhr: Freiparkdauer 60 min, Tagesticket 6,00 EUR, jeder weitere Tag 12,00 EUR; Von 17:00 - 24:00 Uhr keine Bezahlung erforderlich; Bei versäumter Bezahlung werden pro Tag 80,00 EUR berechnet'. All figures match (60 min, not the 120 min of third-party listings; I did not open those listings). Problem: the page says 'Schrankenloses Parken' (no barrier/gate), which the draft renders as 'barrier-free', a term readers will take as step-free accessibility. Page is undated, so date 2026-10 and 'read 21 October 2026' is right.
items.corrected_text: The Gletscherbahnen page, read on 21 October 2026, lists the outdoor car park about 100 m from the valley station in Kurzras as gateless (no barrier or ticket; the number plate is recorded automatically): 60 minutes free from 00:00 to 17:00, then a day ticket of 6 euro and 12 euro for each further day; no payment is required from 17:00 to 24:00. Unpaid stays are charged 80 euro per day. The page is undated.

items.note: Same Anreise page: 'Die Parkraumbewirtschaftung erfolgt durch die Mobility Hub Parkservice Italia S.R.L.'; pay at the Kassenautomat (cash coins only, card, Apple/Google Pay), online via QR code within 24 hours after leaving the car park, and 'Auch die Bezahlung über EasyPark ist möglich'. All as written. Page undated, read 21 Oct 2026 as stated.

Indoor Parking: 'etwa 40 Stellplätze', 1,50 EUR per hour, maximum 18,00 EUR per day, contactless at the exit, automatic card cash desk accessible 24h next to the ticket counter (cash at the ticket counter until 16:30). Those claims match. Disabled bays are wrong: the current page lists two paid bays in the Tiefgarage plus ONE free bay outside (three in total, the page text even has the singular 'ein kostenloser ... Parkplätze'), and does not say 'four'. The older 28.03.2025 news item says four (2+2).
items.corrected_text: The page read on 21 October 2026 gives the indoor car park at the Kurzras valley station as about 40 spaces at 1.50 euro per hour with a daily maximum of 18 euro, payable at the exit by contactless card or at a card machine accessible 24 hours (cash at the ticket counter until 16:30). The page signs three disabled bays: two paid ones in the underground garage and one free one outside directly in front of it.

items.note: News item 'Vieles NEU in der Alpin Arena Schnals', dated 28.03.2025: Indoor Parking 'rund 40 Stellplätze', 'Pro Stunde 2,50 EUR, Maximal pro Tag 24,00 EUR'. Matches. The comparison with the undated current page (1.50 / 18 EUR) is hedged ('apparently lowered') and fair; the reason and date of any change are unknown. Note the same news item names four disabled bays (2 indoor + 2 outside), the current page three.

Bautagebuch: entry 22 'Fertiggestellt - Die Talstation ist fertiggestellt!' dated 23.12.2024; intro: second building phase (2. Baulos) started 8 April 2024; new Gletscherbahn opened 23 December (2023); entry 16 (02.01.2024): about 2,150 m, about 1,180 m height gain, less than 6 minutes, in operation at Christmas 2023. All that matches. The 44-space figure comes only from entry 20 (19.09.2024): 'Der Rohbau der Tiefgarage mit 44 Stellplätzen ist abgeschlossen' (shell construction complete), i.e. a build-stage figure; the operator's own current page and the 28.03.2025 news say about 40 spaces. The draft does not flag this discrepancy.
items.corrected_text: The construction diary of the Schnalstaler Gletscherbahnen reports that the new valley station in Kurzras was completed on 23 December 2024; the second building phase had started in April 2024 and included an underground garage, a restaurant and a covered access to the cable car. A diary entry of 19 September 2024 says the shell of the underground garage 'with 44 spaces' was finished, whereas the operator's parking page and a March 2025 news item give about 40 spaces. The new reversible cable car (about 2,150 m long, about 1,180 m of height gain, under 6 minutes) went into operation at Christmas 2023.

items.note: Anreise page: 'Die Straße ins Schnalstal ist bis Kurzras geteert und ganzjährig befahrbar ... Die Linie 261 verkehrt stündlich von Meran bis nach Kurzras.' Caravan park page https://www.caravanpark-schnals.com/de/schnalstal/anreise-mobilitaet (not the cited source_url, but I read it): 'Ein Linienbus verkehrt tagsüber im Stundentakt von Kurzras ...' and SkibusCard free on Linienbusse/Skibusse 'nur innerhalb des Schnalstals' from October to early May. All matches. Reliability: the two pages differ in scope; the official page says 261 runs from Meran, while a 2022 Südtirolmobil announcement said direct Meran services of 261 would be cancelled; current routing remains unconfirmed. The source_url given covers only the first two claims.

Page (English and German versions) is dated 05.12.2022 (HTML datePublished 2022-12-05; German version shows 05.12.2022); the displayed '12/05/2022' is US month/day format, so the draft's 12 May 2022 is wrong. The text is future tense: 261 Naturns - Schnalstal gets additional early-morning and evening trips and 'continuous hourly services also on Sundays'; 'Direct services to Merano/Meran will be suspended' (German: 'werden gestrichen'), change to line 251 or the train in Naturns. The draft words these as already done.
items.corrected_title: More bus connections in the peripheries (Südtirolmobil news, 05.12.2022)
items.corrected_text: A Südtirolmobil news item dated 5 December 2022 announced more services on line 261 Naturns - Schnalstal (additional early-morning and evening trips and continuous hourly service also on Sundays) and said direct services to Meran on line 261 would be cancelled, with passengers changing to line 251 or the train in Naturns. The Gletscherbahnen page now says line 261 runs hourly from Meran to Kurzras, so the current routing is unconfirmed.

items.note: Caravan park price page: daily price per vehicle 46/41/36 EUR across periods from 27.06.2026 to 09.05.2027, electricity and persons on board included. Home page: 'Auf 40 Stellplätzen ... Die Einfahrt ist rund um die Uhr möglich'. 'Wissenswertes': 'Es sind 80 Stellplätze'. Availability page: booking only online; QR code needed to open the barrier (Schranke) on arrival. All as written; 40 vs 80 contradiction on the operator's own pages is real. Only the price claims are on the cited source_url; the rest are on the operator's other pages.

Gem2go page 'Zahlen und Fakten': 'Einwohner mit Stand am 31.12.2025: 1229'. The figure is right. The second half (visitors, not residents, drive parking demand) is the researcher's inference and appears nowhere on the page.

corrected_summary: Senales (Schnals, population 1,229 at 31 December 2025) is a South Tyrolean valley municipality whose parking centres on the glacier ski area at Kurzras at the valley head, reached by a road that is asphalted and open all year. The operator says bus line 261 runs hourly from Meran to Kurzras, while a 2022 provincial notice announced that direct Meran services would be cancelled with a change at Naturns, so current routing is unconfirmed. The Gemeinderat took decisions on car-park management in Kurzras and conventions with the Schnalstaler Gletscherbahnen AG in May 2023 and November 2024, but only the register titles are published. On the operator's page, read on 21 October 2026, the outdoor car park by the valley station is gateless with number-plate recognition, run by Mobility Hub Parkservice Italia, with 60 minutes free, 6 euro a day and nothing to pay from 17:00 to 24:00, and the indoor car park (about 40 spaces, with the rebuilt valley station completed in December 2024) charges 1.50 euro per hour up to 18 euro a day; a March 2025 news item quoted 2.50 euro per hour and 24 euro a day. In Vernagt the municipality finished a car park and toilets in 2025, runs temporary car parks (2024 to 2026), and decided to introduce paid parking zones on 29 April 2026, with EasyPark and Pagobancomat payment agreements approved on 6 May 2026; tariffs and start dates are unknown. A feasibility study for a car park in Karthaus was commissioned in December 2024. The Caravan Park Schnals at Kurzras is barrier-controlled with online booking; its own pages state 40 and 80 pitches. No information on EV charging was found. Most municipal evidence consists of register titles only.
